title: Revision keeps thought beside the material
meaning: Releasing an inadequate explanation can preserve attention to material when the loss of familiar certainty feels intense for both people.
text: Losing an explanation can feel harder than examining its foundations. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly releasing an inadequate account. The Hermit in energy supports deep reflection on separate observations. The Tower in emotions experiences familiar certainty breaking apart. A customary view may become difficult to retain. Action removes unstable footing while feeling responds to losing a picture that previously seemed obvious to both people.

Suppose you thought only works understood immediately appealed to you. Examining a favourite complicated painting reveals this account’s failure and you stop using it. **Revision can keep thought beside material while certainty is being lost.** Attentive interest allows lingering over one detail. An impression unexplained by the earlier structure gains room. Shock concerns losing a convenient picture of preferences. What you actually notice can be explored without immediately restoring an equally complete account. Your view keeps a concrete subject available to both people even before another general formulation has appeared.

The risk is declaring your taste inconsistent and abandoning examples while the account breaks apart. Deep reflection distinguishes an actual response from its narrow description. The painting still appeals while an earlier measure stopped explaining interest. Your view can hold that difference, allowing the loss of ready certainty alongside continued understanding without requiring an immediate new judgement of yourselves.
